"""Generate the 5-second robotic plate-transfer sequence from first_frame.png."""

from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter

from artifact_io import save


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W, H, N = 256, 160, 20


def polygon_mask(points, feather=0.0):
    mask = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=np.uint8)
    cv2.fillPoly(mask, [np.asarray(points, dtype=np.int32)], 255)
    if feather:
        mask = np.asarray(
            Image.fromarray(mask).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(feather))
        )
    return mask


def composite_warped(frame, rgba, src_anchor, dst_anchor, angle=0.0,
                     scale_x=1.0, scale_y=1.0):
    """Composite a full-canvas RGBA layer with an affine transform."""
    theta = np.deg2rad(angle)
    cos_a, sin_a = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)
    linear = np.array(
        [[scale_x * cos_a, -scale_y * sin_a],
         [scale_x * sin_a, scale_y * cos_a]],
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    src = np.asarray(src_anchor, dtype=np.float64)
    dst = np.asarray(dst_anchor, dtype=np.float64)
    shift = dst - linear @ src
    matrix = np.column_stack((linear, shift))

    rgb = cv2.warpAffine(
        rgba[:, :, :3], matrix, (W, H), flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
        borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT, borderValue=(0, 0, 0),
    )
    alpha = cv2.warpAffine(
        rgba[:, :, 3], matrix, (W, H), flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
        borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT, borderValue=0,
    ).astype(np.float32)[:, :, None] / 255.0
    return np.clip(
        frame.astype(np.float32) * (1.0 - alpha) + rgb.astype(np.float32) * alpha,
        0, 255,
    ).astype(np.uint8)


def tapered_segment(frame, p0, p1, r0, r1, color, edge):
    p0 = np.asarray(p0, dtype=np.float64)
    p1 = np.asarray(p1, dtype=np.float64)
    direction = p1 - p0
    length = np.linalg.norm(direction)
    if length < 1e-6:
        return
    normal = np.array([-direction[1], direction[0]]) / length
    quad = np.array(
        [p0 + normal * r0, p1 + normal * r1,
         p1 - normal * r1, p0 - normal * r0],
        dtype=np.int32,
    )
    cv2.fillConvexPoly(frame, quad, edge, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    inner = np.array(
        [p0 + normal * (r0 - 1.3), p1 + normal * (r1 - 1.3),
         p1 - normal * (r1 - 1.3), p0 - normal * (r0 - 1.3)],
        dtype=np.int32,
    )
    cv2.fillConvexPoly(frame, inner, color, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    highlight0 = p0 + normal * (r0 * 0.30)
    highlight1 = p1 + normal * (r1 * 0.30)
    cv2.line(
        frame, tuple(np.round(highlight0).astype(int)),
        tuple(np.round(highlight1).astype(int)), (78, 79, 77), 1,
        lineType=cv2.LINE_AA,
    )


def draw_arm(frame, shoulder, elbow, wrist, collar_color=(111, 112, 108)):
    shadow = np.array([1, 2], dtype=np.int32)
    tapered_segment(
        frame, np.asarray(shoulder) + shadow, np.asarray(elbow) + shadow,
        9.5, 7.0, (19, 20, 20), (10, 11, 12),
    )
    tapered_segment(
        frame, np.asarray(elbow) + shadow, np.asarray(wrist) + shadow,
        7.0, 5.5, (20, 21, 21), (10, 11, 12),
    )
    tapered_segment(frame, shoulder, elbow, 9.0, 6.6, (36, 37, 37), (15, 16, 17))
    tapered_segment(frame, elbow, wrist, 6.6, 5.0, (42, 43, 43), (16, 17, 18))
    cv2.circle(frame, tuple(np.round(elbow).astype(int)), 7, (20, 21, 21),
               -1, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    cv2.circle(frame, tuple(np.round(elbow).astype(int)), 5, (48, 49, 48),
               -1, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    wrist_i = tuple(np.round(wrist).astype(int))
    cv2.circle(frame, wrist_i, 6, (23, 24, 24), -1, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)

def composite_warped(frame, rgba, src_anchor, dst_anchor, angle=0.0,
                     scale_x=1.0, scale_y=1.0):
    """Composite a full-canvas RGBA layer with an affine transform."""
    theta = np.deg2rad(angle)
    cos_a, sin_a = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)
    linear = np.array(
        [[scale_x * cos_a, -scale_y * sin_a],
         [scale_x * sin_a, scale_y * cos_a]],
        dtype=np.float64,
    )
    src = np.asarray(src_anchor, dtype=np.float64)
    dst = np.asarray(dst_anchor, dtype=np.float64)
    shift = dst - linear @ src
    matrix = np.column_stack((linear, shift))

    rgb = cv2.warpAffine(
        rgba[:, :, :3], matrix, (W, H), flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
        borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT, borderValue=(0, 0, 0),
    )
    alpha = cv2.warpAffine(
        rgba[:, :, 3], matrix, (W, H), flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
        borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT, borderValue=0,
    ).astype(np.float32)[:, :, None] / 255.0
    return np.clip(
        frame.astype(np.float32) * (1.0 - alpha) + rgb.astype(np.float32) * alpha,
        0, 255,
    ).astype(np.uint8)


def tapered_segment(frame, p0, p1, r0, r1, color, edge):
    p0 = np.asarray(p0, dtype=np.float64)
    p1 = np.asarray(p1, dtype=np.float64)
    direction = p1 - p0
    length = np.linalg.norm(direction)
    if length < 1e-6:
        return
    normal = np.array([-direction[1], direction[0]]) / length
    quad = np.array(
        [p0 + normal * r0, p1 + normal * r1,
         p1 - normal * r1, p0 - normal * r0],
        dtype=np.int32,
    )
    cv2.fillConvexPoly(frame, quad, edge, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    inner = np.array(
        [p0 + normal * (r0 - 1.3), p1 + normal * (r1 - 1.3),
         p1 - normal * (r1 - 1.3), p0 - normal * (r0 - 1.3)],
        dtype=np.int32,
    )
    cv2.fillConvexPoly(frame, inner, color, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    highlight0 = p0 + normal * (r0 * 0.30)
    highlight1 = p1 + normal * (r1 * 0.30)
    cv2.line(
        frame, tuple(np.round(highlight0).astype(int)),
        tuple(np.round(highlight1).astype(int)), (78, 79, 77), 1,
        lineType=cv2.LINE_AA,
    )


def draw_arm(frame, shoulder, elbow, wrist, collar_color=(111, 112, 108)):
    shadow = np.array([1, 2], dtype=np.int32)
    tapered_segment(
        frame, np.asarray(shoulder) + shadow, np.asarray(elbow) + shadow,
        9.5, 7.0, (19, 20, 20), (10, 11, 12),
    )
    tapered_segment(
        frame, np.asarray(elbow) + shadow, np.asarray(wrist) + shadow,
        7.0, 5.5, (20, 21, 21), (10, 11, 12),
    )
    tapered_segment(frame, shoulder, elbow, 9.0, 6.6, (36, 37, 37), (15, 16, 17))
    tapered_segment(frame, elbow, wrist, 6.6, 5.0, (42, 43, 43), (16, 17, 18))
    cv2.circle(frame, tuple(np.round(elbow).astype(int)), 7, (20, 21, 21),
               -1, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    cv2.circle(frame, tuple(np.round(elbow).astype(int)), 5, (48, 49, 48),
               -1, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    wrist_i = tuple(np.round(wrist).astype(int))
    cv2.circle(frame, wrist_i, 6, (23, 24, 24), -1, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    cv2.circle(frame, wrist_i, 4, collar_color, -1, lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)


def main():

    assert image.shape == (H, W, 3)

    plate_points = [
        (163, 21), (169, 23), (176, 33), (179, 43), (178, 55),
        (173, 64), (166, 70), (158, 69), (152, 63), (149, 54),
        (150, 39), (155, 27),
    ]
    plate_mask = polygon_mask(plate_points, feather=0.65)

        (232, 76), (238, 70), (244, 67), (249, 71), (249, 78),
        (245, 84), (242, 90), (241, 97), (243, 104), (247, 111),
        (251, 119), (247, 128), (240, 132), (232, 131), (226, 126),
        (222, 120), (216, 116), (211, 112),
    ]
    left_hand_mask = polygon_mask(left_hand_points, feather=0.45)
    right_hand_mask = polygon_mask(right_hand_points, feather=0.45)

    # The full arm footprints include the hands and the visible lower linkages.
    left_arm_region = polygon_mask([
        (17, 160), (20, 146), (29, 137), (42, 130), (52, 124),
        (57, 115), (55, 104), (59, 94), (66, 87), (75, 90),

    removal = np.maximum.reduce([plate_mask, left_arm_region, right_arm_region])
    removal = cv2.dilate((removal > 18).astype(np.uint8) * 255,
                         np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8), iterations=1)
    base = cv2.inpaint(image, removal, 4, cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)

        frame = composite_warped(
            frame, right_rgba, right_anchor, tuple(right_wrist),

        frame = composite_warped(
            frame, left_rgba, left_anchor, tuple(left_wrist),
            left_angle, left_sx, 1.0,
        )

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))
